summary_en: FY2027/3 (year ended Mar 2027) annual dividend raised to ¥70.00/share from ¥58.00. Interim (Q2) dividend ¥35.00, year-end (Q4) dividend ¥35.00. Payout ratio target 30%+ of net income. Upgrade reflects upside to earnings guidance (operating profit +32.8% to ¥85.0B, net income +50.0% to ¥42.0B) driven by strong sales and recycled-material capacity expansion.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, UACJ Corporation announced an upward revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2027 (FY2027/3). The annual dividend per share has been increased to ¥70.00 from the previously forecast ¥58.00, representing a 12-yen (20.7%) hike. The dividend will be paid in two equal instalments: an interim dividend (Q2) of ¥35.00 and a year-end dividend (Q4) of ¥35.00. The increase is driven by an upward revision to consolidated earnings guidance announced on the same date. Operating profit is now forecast at ¥85.0 billion (up 32.8% from ¥64.0 billion), and net income attributable to parent company owners is projected at ¥42.0 billion (up 50.0% from ¥28.0 billion). Management attributed the uplift to robust sales performance and expanded benefits from investments in recycled-material processing capacity. The company maintains its baseline dividend policy of paying out 30% or more of net income over the fourth medium-term management plan period (FY2024–FY2027).
